title: model-specific-runtime-optimizations-llama-mistral-qwen-gqa-mqa-tuning
author: Alexandra Chen
release_notes: Improves tail latency and throughput for Llama/Mistral/Qwen by adjusting kernel selection heuristics, scheduler pacing, KV-cache hot-paths and quantization tuning (GQA/MQA). Backward-compatible runtime flags provided for rollout.
description: Motivation: We observed model-specific regressions and suboptimal throughput for a subset of customer workloads (Llama-family, Mistral, Qwen). Root causes: kernel selection choosing non-optimal CUDA kernels for certain layer shapes, scheduler mis-pacing for mixed-sequence workloads, KV cache eviction hot-path overhead, and quantization scoring (GQA/MQA) not tuned per-arch/weight layout. This PR introduces a set of targeted runtime optimizations and feature gates to improve latency and throughput while maintaining deterministic outputs and safe rollouts. Changes: 1) Kernel selector heuristics: add model-aware heuristics to prefer fused attention kernels for Llama shapes and alternate GEMM tiling for Mistral dense blocks; fallback paths preserved. 2) Scheduler/pacing: introduce a lightweight pacing token that reduces head-of-line blocking on mixed-length requests and defers large-batch kernel launches slightly to increase packing efficiency for continuous batching. 3) KV cache hot-path: reduce locking in common read path by introducing an epoch-based fast-path for cache hits and optimize memory layout for Qwen KV tensors. 4) Continuous batching: improved batching window heuristics for low-latency modes and an adaptive max-batch estimator that uses running percentiles per model. 5) GQA/MQA tuning: per-model calibration maps for quantization scoring that adjust group sizes and scale heuristics for Qwen and Mistral weight layouts; added a conservative fallback to standard quantization if scoring indicates quality risk. 6) Telemetry + rollout: add per-model perf counters, new dashboards, and runtime feature flags (rt.gqa_tune, rt.kv_epoch_fastpath, rt.kernel_selector_model_hint) to allow staged rollout. Testing & Benchmarks: microbenchmarks (latency p50/p95, tokens/sec) were run on rtx-a100 and triton-1 nodes using the perf harness. Observed improvements: Llama-2-70B: +18% throughput, -12% p95 latency on chat workload; Mistral-Instruct-7B: +22% throughput, -15% p95; Qwen-110B: +13% throughput with KV hot-path enabled. We also added unit tests, integration perf tests, and a repro case used by Support (SUP-827). Migration / Compatibility: All changes are opt-in via feature flags; default rollout enabled for canary fleet after this merge. Known risk: rare numerical differences when using tuned quantization maps - we added regression evals and an automatic rollback threshold. Checklist: - [x] Kernel selector heuristics implemented and unit tested - [x] Scheduler pacing + continuous batching heuristics added - [x] KV cache fast-path implemented and bench-tested - [x] GQA/MQA per-model tuning + fallbacks - [x] Perf harness results attached and validated - [x] Feature flags and telemetry added - [x] Docs/console notes for rollout. See commits summary and changed files for details.
